summary.intent: Execute a wave-based orchestrated implementation phase (68.1: web client runtime integration) end-to-end via GSD workflows — first full execution of 14 plans across 5 waves, then gap-closure planning and execution after verification surfaced failures in real-world e2e testing and live user testing.
summary.outcome: 14 initial plans executed and merged (58 commits), but phase verification found only 2/5 success criteria met; e2e went from 6/208 to ~190/208 passing but with real bugs (folder-store UUID/ipnsName desync, kind-cache never consulted in file list/context menu/shared browser, missing TEE republish enrollment causing dead IPNS records). User live-tested and found subfolder navigation broken after logout, confirming a durability gap; gap-closure planning produced 8 more plans (68.1-15 through 68.1-22), of which several were executed (kind-cache shared-browser wiring, TDD durable registration, GAP-4/5/6 triage) with one fixture regression caught and repaired before wave 3 could proceed.

repo: Web app has no SdkContext bridge, so web-native primitives (ipns.service.ts's resolveIpnsRecord, ctx-free fetchFromIpfs) must be used instead of sdk-core's ctx-based helpers — this also preserves an anti-rollback (ROT-07) floor sdk-core's raw resolveIpnsRecord lacks
resolveFileMetadata needs the full SealedChildRef (not just fileIpnsName) because readKeySealed/generation live only on the parent's SealedChildRef and aren't derivable from ipnsName alone

The live /shares and /shares/invites REST API grants an entire subtree via one ECIES wrap of the root readKey — there is no server-side per-child-key field, so the plan-specified collectChildKeys/ChildKeyDto design is dead code; ShareDialog/invite.service.ts call resolveChildNodeIdentity directly instead

sdk-core's issueReadGrant/claimInvite (grant.ts) produce base64 payloads but the live DTOs are hex-only — web code calls wrapKey/unwrapKey directly with hex encoding instead of routing through sdk-core's grant primitives

Write-permission share/invite creation requires the parent folder's writeKey, which only exists inside CipherBoxClient's private FolderState — no web UI layer has it threaded through (SHARE-WRITE-KEY gap), and there's no backend upgrade-permission endpoint (would need revoke+recreate)
sdk-core's updateFileMetadata claimed via doc comment to zero fileIpnsPrivateKey but never actually did — a latent bug (T-47-01) found and fixed during 68.1-12

createFolder published child IPNS records without encryptedIpnsPrivateKey/keyEpoch, so nothing enrolled in ipns_republish_schedule — every subfolder record would die at the 48h IPNS TTL in production; fixed in 68.1-16
mock-ipns-routing keeps IPNS records in an in-memory Map — every container restart wipes unpublished-to-DB records permanently, manufacturing false 'propagation timeout' failures in dev

mock-ipns-routing's healthcheck used `wget localhost` which resolves to ::1 (IPv6) while the app binds IPv4-only, causing perpetual unhealthy status unrelated to actual service health — fixed by pinning to 127.0.0.1 in docker-compose.yml
API runs on :3000, not :3001 — :3001 is the delegated-routing mock (DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL target for web-e2e), a common source of confused health probes

Migration 1750000000000-ApiSchemaCutover dropped the shares table's plaintext item_name column entirely (not renamed); share.service.ts hardcodes itemName: '', making the REQ-4 backfill feature permanently dead code — reviving it would require plaintext server-side name storage, which violates the project's zero-knowledge rule (documented as GAP-6, left as a decision rather than unilaterally fixed)

D-05 stale-record rejection toast bug: the ROT-07 sequence floor bumps pre-publish, one step behind the client's own subsequent publish, so a relay replay from just before that publish exactly matches the floor and slips through enforceResolved as a plain ReconcileStaleError, retried uniformly for ~30s regardless of direction — fixed by adding localSequence/networkSequence to the error and making retry only fire when network is ahead of local
gsd-tools decision-coverage gate requires the informational tag placed inside the bold ID group — `- **D-04 [informational]:**` — not appended after it, or the tag doesn't register

code.finding: Hardcoded isFolder = true meant the D-02 kind cache populated in 68.1-14 was never consulted in the shared browser, so files rendered as folders and per-item download was wired to undefined — fixed in 68.1-15

createFolder now enrolls new subfolders in TEE republish (encryptedIpnsPrivateKey/keyEpoch) fail-closed before any addToIpfs side effect (68.1-16); ReconcileStaleError gained localSequence/networkSequence fields (68.1-21) to make retry direction-aware
restoreFromBin hardened to warn (non-throwing) when a restored child's own IPNS record fails to resolve post-relink, rather than silently succeeding with a dead link (68.1-16)

workflow: gsd execute-phase wave orchestration: worktree-isolated parallel subagents per plan within a wave, orchestrator records worktree metadata as each returns, merges the whole wave at once, then runs post-merge build/test/drift gates before advancing

Subagent-reported worktree_metadata.expected_base can be wrong (agent misreports its own HEAD/docs-commit instead of the true fork point) — orchestrator verified the true fork base via git before recording/merging in the 68.1-21 case

A background agent's completion signal can be lost (session evicted) even after the underlying long-running command (e.g., a 208-spec Playwright suite) finishes — orchestrator had to detect this via process-liveness + log inspection and resume the agent manually via SendMessage with the recovered results

Headed Playwright runs are useful for building direct user confidence and often reveal that serial spec suites abort at first failure, making raw pass/fail counts overstate coverage since most failing groups die in setup, leaving real test bodies unexecuted
TDD review-checkpoint advisory gate and post-planning gap-analysis advisory gate are separate non-blocking hooks run explicitly by the orchestrator after commits, not automatic

friction: Wave 1 agent for plan 68.1-01 stalled mid-stream after 119 tool calls (~23 min); orchestrator had to spot-check filesystem/git state and resume it in the background per the workflow's completion-signal fallback

Wave 5 exit-gate agent's completion signal was lost after the 208-spec Playwright suite (~23 min) finished — no re-invocation occurred until the user pushed back with 'its been way too long', forcing manual liveness/log investigation and agent resumption
Decision-coverage gate initially failed on D-04's informational tag placement; required reading the parser's tag-matching logic to discover the tag must sit inside the bold ID group
git index.lock transient contention during Wave 3 tracking commit required a retry after confirming no live git process held it
A `tail`-piped test command masked a real non-zero exit code during the gap-wave-2 post-merge gate, hiding an actual sdk test failure until re-run with direct capture

68.1-17 subagent mistakenly ran a prohibited `git stash push` on bin/index.ts mid-task; recovered correctly via manual reapply (not stash pop) but left a stray stash entry the orchestrator had to identify and drop separately from the user's own pre-existing stashes
Task list (TaskCreate/TaskUpdate state) did not survive a session hand-off after the exit-gate triage agent's long continuation run, forcing the orchestrator to proceed without it
Bash permission denial when trying to read .env-adjacent compose config required splitting the command to work around it
open_items: GAP-1: resolveFileMetadata AEAD decrypt failure breaks CTR/streaming video preview and batch-download — undiagnosed at phase-verification time

GAP-2 (reframed): what looked like IPNS propagation timeout was actually mock-ipns-routing's in-memory store being wiped by container restarts, compounded by records with no ipns_records DB row dying permanently — needs durable child-record registration + republish enrollment as a systemic fix beyond 68.1-16's createFolder-only patch

GAP-6: REQ-4 itemName backfill is dead code since migration 1750000000000-ApiSchemaCutover dropped shares.item_name — needs a deliberate feature-retirement or redesign decision (reviving plaintext storage would violate zero-knowledge), explicitly left undecided by the 68.1-21 agent

SHARE-WRITE-KEY web-wiring gap: write-permission share/invite creation is fail-closed in the UI because parent folder writeKey isn't threaded to any web UI layer; also no backend upgrade-permission endpoint exists at all
fetchShareKeys remains a deferred stub causing shared move/update-fallback to fail closed on four live paths

Full web-e2e suite was not re-confirmed green after the 5 triage fixes in 68.1-13 (folder-store id-desync fix included) — a re-run was expected to clear a chunk of the original 17 failures but had not been executed as of phase verification
WEB-04 deliberately left unmarked in REQUIREMENTS.md/ROADMAP.md pending gap closure
